sources.note: Town of Newfane (official website), Selectboard page: lists the five-member selectboard as Todd Lawley (Chair), Marion Dowling (Vice Chair), Michael Fitzpatrick, Christopher Cleverly, and Katy Johnson-Aplin; printed expiries of 2026 for Lawley, Dowling, and Fitzpatrick are stale against the maintained page, which is current
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): lists Wannetta Powling as Newfane's town clerk
Town of Newfane, 2025 Annual Town Report: the officers table carries Powling as town clerk on the town's one-year cycle
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): names Melissa Brown as Newfane's town treasurer
Town of Newfane (official website), Treasurer / Tax Collector office page: presents Melissa Brown as the town's current treasurer
Town of Newfane (official website), Treasurer / Tax Collector office page: presents the treasurer / tax collector as one elected office held by Melissa Brown
Town of Newfane, 2025 Annual Town Report: the elected officers table lists the collector of delinquent taxes separately among the elected offices

Town of Newfane, 2025 Annual Town Report: the officers table lists listers Frank Suponski (to 2027) and Mary F. Hildebrandt (to 2028); the third seat, held by Doris Knechtel on a one-year term expiring 2026, stood at the March 2026 meeting with no published outcome and is left unfilled, Knechtel held as a straggler

Town of Newfane, 2025 Annual Town Report: the officers table lists Constable Eric Durocher with a term expiring 2026; the March 2026 outcome is published in no official source located, so the post is created without a membership and Durocher is held as a straggler
Town of Newfane, 2025 Annual Town Report: the officers table lists Moderator Kim Friedman with a term expiring 2026; the post is created without a membership and Friedman is held as a straggler

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists seven Newfane justices of the peace elected November 5, 2024; the town report's justice column names a partly different seven (see the election note) and the listing governs

jp_election.name: Town of Newfane Justice of the Peace Election 2024-11-05

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists seven Newfane justices of the peace elected November 5, 2024: Priscilla Cottron, Gloria Cristelli, Fiona Chevalier, Lynn Forrest, Caroline Apple Gifford, Steve Levine, and Kate Gehring. The town report's justice column names Cottron (spelled 'Cotton'), Cristelli, Gifford, and Levine, plus Sandra Dadik, Abigail Dillon, and Evelyn Sirois, omitting Chevalier, Forrest, and Gehring -- an equal-count name swap, so the certified listing governs and Dadik, Dillon, and Sirois (possible mid-term Board of Civil Authority appointees) are held as stragglers in this note. The listing publishes no vote totals or party labels and none are recorded
Town of Newfane, 2025 Annual Town Report: the officers table's justice of the peace column names a partly different set of seven (see the election note)
